title: Design, synthesis, and biological evaluation of naphthoylamide derivatives as inhibitors of STAT3 phosphorylation.
authors: Lu, JiaHao; Yan, XiuYang; Lai, WuJi; Jiang, Li-He; Shen, Li-Qun; Wu, Ai-Qun; Zhao, Chengguang
one_liner_zh: 该文设计萘甲酰胺类小分子抑制剂靶向STAT3磷酸化，虽含分子对接与动态模拟，但对象为蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且未涉及TF-DNA结合机制，仅边缘相关。
abstract: The phosphorylation of STAT3 plays a critical physiological role in the proliferation of rectal cancer. Hence, inhibiting STAT3 phosphorylation is an effective anticancer approach. In this work, we designed a novel 5-R'-1-naphthylmethylamide scaffold as a small molecule inhibitor of STAT3 phosphorylation. The results showed that 3D and 4D have exceptional inhibitory ability against three different colorectal cancer (CRC) cell lines, and can induce apoptosis of CRC cells by inhibiting STAT3 phosphorylation, while having no killing effect on normal human cells. 3D and 4D can inhibit STAT3 phosphorylation in a time- and concentration-dependent manner, and also inhibit the nuclear translocation of interleukin (IL)-6-induced STAT3. In the in vivo tumor model research, 4D significantly reduced the tumor volume of mice and had no drug toxicity on other organ tissues. Furthermore, molecular docking studies revealed that 3D and 4D had greater binding free energy when interacting with the STAT3 SH2 structural domain, and could establish H-pi interaction modes. Dynamic simulation studies indicated that both compounds were able to bind tightly to STAT3.
abstract_zh: STAT3的磷酸化在直肠癌增殖中发挥关键的生理作用。因此，抑制STAT3磷酸化是一种有效的抗癌策略。在本研究中，我们设计了一种新型5-R'-1-萘甲基酰胺骨架作为STAT3磷酸化的小分子抑制剂。结果表明，3D和4D对三种不同的结直肠癌（CRC）细胞系具有优异的抑制能力，并能通过抑制STAT3磷酸化诱导CRC细胞凋亡，同时对正常人体细胞无杀伤作用。3D和4D能以时间和浓度依赖性方式抑制STAT3磷酸化，并抑制白细胞介素（IL）-6诱导的STAT3核转位。在体内肿瘤模型研究中，4D显著减小了小鼠的肿瘤体积，且对其他器官组织无药物毒性。此外，分子对接研究揭示，3D和4D在与STAT3 SH2结构域相互作用时具有更大的结合自由能，并能建立H-π相互作用模式。动态模拟研究表明，这两种化合物均能紧密结合STAT3。
